indexing.label: Indexing
indexing.help: Picks up file changes and updates the semantic search index. When OFF, new files are not included in search.

search.label: Semantic search
search.help: Enables semantic search in the search screen. When OFF, intelligence search is disabled; filename search still works.

rag.label: AI question answering (Ask)
rag.help: Enables Ask. Each question sends file contents such as captions and text to the LLM API.

auto_tags.label: AI tag candidates
auto_tags.help: Creates tag candidates from file contents. Manual only creates them when requested; Auto creates them during indexing. Candidates are not applied until you add them.

summaries.label: AI summary (short)
summaries.help: Creates a one-sentence summary and a slightly longer paragraph summary. Auto creates summaries per file, increasing usage.

detailed_summaries.label: AI detailed summary (Markdown)
detailed_summaries.help: Creates a longer summary with a key-points table. Auto can use a lot per file, so a local LLM or lower-cost LLM is recommended.

transcript_refine.label: AI transcript cleanup
transcript_refine.help: Cleans up transcripts with an LLM, including punctuation and homophone fixes. Originals are kept and can always be restored. Full transcripts are sent to the LLM API.

vision_describe.label: AI image description
vision_describe.help: Creates image descriptions with an LLM. Image data is sent to the LLM API. For drives with private photos, use Off or a local vision model. Requires vision_model to be set on the LLM provider.

retrieval_keywords.label: AI search keyword expansion
retrieval_keywords.help: Creates helper keywords such as synonyms, abbreviations, and alternate names per file, then stores them in a dedicated search index. This helps cover proper nouns that speech recognition may misread. Transcript or document text (up to 8,000 characters) is sent to the LLM API.

llm.title: LLM provider
llm.description: Configures the language model used for tag candidates, summaries, Ask, and image descriptions. Data being processed is sent to the configured LLM API endpoint. Cloud providers require an API key in the environment. Restart the container for changes to take effect.

personalHistory.label: Use viewing history
personalHistory.help: Lets inputs like "what I watched last week" or "things I haven't seen this month" filter to your own viewing history. Requires a profile.

categoryExpansion.label: Expand semantic categories
categoryExpansion.help: Expands vague input such as "sci-fi-ish" or "horror-style" into related keywords for search.
